H8000.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07999»; to complete, to restore:--deliver, finish.

H8002.def: from «07999»; properly, requital, i.e. a (voluntary) sacrifice in thanks:--peace offering.

H8003.def: from «07999»; complete (literally or figuratively); especially friendly:--full, just, made ready, peaceable, perfect(-ed), quiet, Shalem (by mistake for a name), whole.

H8004.def: the same as «08003»; peaceful; Shalem, an early name of Jerusalem:--Salem.

H8006.def: the same as «08005»; Shillem, an Israelite:--Shillem.

H8007.def: probably for «08008»; clothing; Salma, the name of two Israelites:--Salma.

H8008.def: transp. for «08071»; a dress:--clothes, garment, raiment.

H8009.def: the same as «08008»; clothing; Salmah, an Israelite:--Salmon. Compare «08012».

H8012.def: from «08008»; investiture; Salmon, an Israelite:--Salmon. Compare «08009».

H8013.def: feminine plural of «07965»; pacifications; Shelomoth, the name of two Israelites:--Shelomith (from the margin), Shelomoth. Compare «08019».

H8016.def: patronymically from «08006»; a Shilemite (collectively) or descendants of Shillem:--Shillemites.

H8017.def: from «07965» and «0410»; peace of God; Shelumiel, an Israelite:--Shelumiel.

H8018.def: or Shelemyahuw {shel-em-yaw'-hoo}; from «08002» and «03050»; thank-offering of Jah; Shelemjah, the name of nine Israelites:--Shelemiah.

H8019.def: or Shlowmiyth (Ezra 8:10) {shel-o- meeth'}; from «07965»; peaceableness; Shelomith, the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses:--Shelomith.

H8020.def: of foreign derivation; Shalman, a king apparently of Assyria:--Shalman. Compare «08022».

H8022.def: of foreign derivation; Shalmaneser, an Assyrian king:--Shalmaneser. Comp «08020».

H8023.def: the same as «07888»; Shiloni, an Israelite:--Shiloni.

H8024.def: from «07956»; a Shelanite (collectively), or descendants of Shelah:--Shelanites.

H8025.def: a primitive root; to pull out, up or off:--draw (off), grow up, pluck off.

H8026.def: from «08025»; extract; Sheleph, a son of Jokthan:--Sheleph.

H8027.et: a primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, i.e. treble
H8027.def: a primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, i.e. treble; but apparently used only as denominative from «07969», to be (causatively, make) triplicate (by restoration, in portions, strands, days or years):--do the third time, (divide into, stay) three (days, - fold, parts, years old).

H8029.def: from «08027»; a descendant of the third degree, i.e. great grandchild:--third (generation).

H8030.def: feminine from the same as «08028»; triplication; Shilshah, an Israelite:--Shilshah.

H8031.def: feminine from «08027»; trebled land; Shalishah, a place in Palestine:--Shalisha.

H8032.def: or shilshom {shil-shome'}; from the same as «08028»; trebly, i.e. (in time) day before yesterday:--+ before (that time, - time), excellent things (from the margin), + heretofore, three days, + time past.

H8033.et: a primitive particle [rather from the relative pronoun, (0834)]; there (transferring to time) then
H8033.def: a primitive particle (rather from the relative pronoun, «0834»); there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence:--in it, + thence, there (-in, + of, + out), + thither, + whither.

H8034.et: a primitive word [perhaps rather from (07760) through the idea of definite and conspicuous position
H8034.def: a primitive word (perhaps rather from «07760» through the idea of definite and conspicuous position; compare «08064»); an appellation, as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character:--+ base, (in-)fame(-ous), named(-d), renown, report.

H8035.def: the same as «08034»; name; Shem, a son of Noah (often includ. his posterity):--Sem, Shem.

H8038.def: apparently from «08034» and «083»; name of pinion, i.e. illustrious; Shemeber, a king of Zeboim:--Shemeber.

H8039.def: perhaps for «08093»; Shimah, an Israelite:--Shimah. Compare «08043».

H8040.et: a primitive word [rather perhaps from the same as (08071) (by insertion of the aleph) through the idea of wrapping up]
H8040.def: or smosl {sem-ole'}; a primitive word (rather perhaps from the same as «08071» (by insertion of the aleph) through the idea of wrapping up); properly, dark (as enveloped), i.e. the north; hence (by orientation), the left hand:--left (hand, side).

H8041.def: a primitive root (denominative from «08040»); to use the left hand or pass in that direction):--(go, turn) (on the, to the) left.

H8042.def: from «08040»; situated on the left side:--left.

H8044.def: of uncertain derivation; Shamgar, an Israelite judge:--Shamgar.

H8045.def: a primitive root; to desolate:--destory(- uction), bring to nought, overthrow, perish, pluck down, × utterly.

H8047.def: from «08074»; ruin; by implication, consternation:--astonishment, desolate(-ion), waste, wonderful thing.

H8048.def: the same as «08047»; Shammah, the name of an Edomite and four Israelites:--Shammah.

H8050.et: from the pass part of (08085) and (0410)
H8050.def: from the passive participle of «08085» and «0410»; heard of God; Shemuel, the name of three Israelites:--Samuel, Shemuel.

H8051.def: from «08074»; renowned; Shammua, the name of four Israelites:--Shammua, Shammuah.

H8052.def: feminine passive participle of «08074»; something heard, i.e. an announcement:--bruit, doctrine, fame, mentioned, news, report, rumor, tidings.

H8053.def: passive participle of «08103»; observed; Shamur, an Israelite:--Shamir (from the margin).

H8054.def: plural of «08047»; ruins; Shammoth, an Israelite:--Shamoth.

H8055.def: a primitive root; probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome:--cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, × very.

H8056.def: from «08055»; blithe or gleeful:--(be) glad, joyful, (making) merry((-hearted), -ily), rejoice(-ing).

H8057.def: from «08056»; blithesomeness or glee, (religious or festival):--X exceeding(-ly), gladness, joy(-fulness), mirth, pleasure, rejoice(-ing).

H8058.def: a primitive root; to fling down; incipiently to jostle; figuratively, to let alone, desist, remit:--discontinue, overthrow, release, let rest, shake, stumble, throw down.

H8059.def: from «08058»; remission (of debt) or suspension of labor):--release.

H8060.def: from «08073»; destructive; Shammai, the name of three Israelites:--Shammai.

H8061.def: apparently from «08034» and «03045»; name of knowing; Shemida, an Israelite:--Shemida, Shemidah.

H8062.def: patronymically from «08061»; a Shemidaite (collectively) or descendants of Shemida:--Shemidaites.

H8063.def: from «05564»; a run (as sustaining the Oriental sitter):--mantle.

H8064.et: from an unused root meaning to be lofty
H8064.def: dual of an unused singular shameh {shaw-meh'}; from an unused root meaning to be lofty; the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve):--air, × astrologer, heaven(-s).

H8067.def: feminine of «08066»; probably an eight-stringed lyre:--Sheminith.

H8068.et: from (08104) in the original sense of pricking
H8068.def: from «08104» in the original sense of pricking; a thorn; also (from its keenness for scratching) a gem, probably the diamond:--adamant (stone), brier, diamond.

H8069.def: the same as «08068»; Shamir, the name of two places in Palestine:--Shamir. Compare «08053».

H8070.def: or Shmariymowth {shem-aw-ree- moth'}; probably from «08034» and plural of «07413»; name of heights; Shemiramoth, the name of two Israelites:--Shemiramoth.

H8071.et: perhaps by permutation for the fem. of (05566) (through the idea of a cover assuming the shape of the object beneath)
H8071.def: perhaps by permutation for the feminine of «05566» (through the idea of a cover assuming the shape of the object beneath); a dress, especially a mantle:--apparel, cloth(-es, -ing), garment, raiment. Compare «08008».

H8072.def: probably for the same as «08071»; Samlah, an Edomite:--Samlah.

H8073.def: for «08014»; Shamlai, one of the Nethinim:--Shalmai (from the margin).

H8074.def: a primitive root; to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense):--make amazed, be astonied, (be an) astonish(-ment), (be, bring into, unto, lay, lie, make) desolate(-ion, places), be destitute, destroy (self), (lay, lie, make) waste, wonder.

H8077.def: or shimamah {shee-mam-aw'}; feminine of «08076»; devastation; figuratively, astonishment:--(laid, × most) desolate(- ion), waste.

H8079.et: probably from (08074) (in the sense of poisoning)
H8079.def: probably from «08074» (in the sense of poisoning); a lizard (from the superstition of its noxiousness):--spider.

H8080.def: a primitive root; to shine, i.e. (by analogy) be (causatively, make) oily or gross:--become (make, wax) fat.

H8081.def: from «08080»; grease, especially liquid (as from the olive, often perfumed); figuratively, richness:--anointing, × fat (things), × fruitful, oil((-ed)), ointment, olive, + pine.

H8082.def: from «08080»; greasy, i.e. gross; figuratively, rich:--fat, lusty, plenteous.

H8083.et: apparently from (08082) through the idea of plumpness
H8083.def: or shmowneh {shem-o-neh'}; feminine shmonah {shem-o-naw'}; or shmownah {shem-o-naw'}; apparently from «08082» through the idea of plumpness; a cardinal number, eight (as if a surplus above the "perfect" seven); also (as ordinal) eighth:--eight((-een, -eenth)), eighth.

H8084.def: or shmowniym {shem-o-neem'}; mult. from «08083»; eighty, also eightieth:--eighty(-ieth), fourscore.

H8085.def: a primitive root; to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.):--X attentively, call (gather) together, × carefully, × certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, × diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), × indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, × surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.

H8087.def: for the same as «08088»; Shema, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites:--Shema.

H8088.def: from «08085»; something heard, i.e. a sound, rumor, announcement; abstractly, audience:--bruit, fame, hear(-ing), loud, report, speech, tidings.

H8090.def: for «08087»; Shema, a place in Palestine:--Shema.

H8092.def: for «08093»; Shima, the name of four Israelites:--Shimea, Shimei, Shamma.

H8093.def: feminine of «08088»; annunciation; Shimah, an Israelite:--Shimeah.

H8095.def: from «08085»; hearing; Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descended from him:--Simeon.

H8096.def: from «08088»; famous; Shimi, the name of twenty Israelites:--Shimeah (from the margin), Shimei, Shimhi, Shimi.

H8097.def: patronymically from «08096»; a Shimite (collectively) or descendants of Shimi:--of Shimi, Shimites.

H8098.def: or Shmamyahuw {shem-aw-yaw'-hoo}; from «08085» and «03050»; Jah has heard; Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites:--Shemaiah.

H8099.def: patronymically from «08095»; a Shimonite (collectively) or descendants of Shimon:--tribe of Simeon, Simeonites.
